This initiative will be led by a cross-functional team reporting to me, and I will be personally involved in the effort.

The objective of this initiative is to reduce <ORG>'s cost structure by at least $400 million through the end of 2002.  This will require a complete review of all expenses in light of current business activity.  We will begin this process immediately and are prepared to make decisions quickly.  

Our business units will continue to focus on increasing revenues and improving operating efficiencies.  They will also be asked to identify additional costs that can be cut.  The corporate functions will also be asked to identify costs that can be reduced or eliminated.  We will also be working with outside vendors to identify opportunities for cost savings.
